transcript: There are three things you need to stop doing immediately if you want to be happier, and the last one can change everything. But first, save this and send it to someone who needs to hear it. Number one, stop regretting the past. There's nothing you can do about it anymore. Don't forget the past because you can learn from it and grow from it so you don't repeat the same mistakes. But constantly regretting it only keeps you stuck. Number two, stop worrying about the future. Psychologists say that about 85% of the things people worry about every day never actually happen. So most of that anxiety is just wasted energy and wasted time. And number three, stop looking for happiness in other people. No one else can make you happy. It's impossible. Real happiness is something you build inside yourself, not something you borrow from someone else.
